display_title: Where No One Has Gone Before

evidence.observation: Picard prioritizes returning home over immediate scientific exploitation of the region; the Traveler privately urges Picard to encourage Wesley's unusual aptitude without telling him its predicted significance.
evidence.qualification: Records what the transcript depicts or reports; no global fictional-world promotion is implied.

evidence.observation: Picard orders the crew to focus thought on duty or the Traveler; the return attempt succeeds, after which Data reports the Traveler has phased completely out of their existence and Picard announces the ship is back in its own galaxy.
evidence.qualification: The Traveler's post-return state is unresolved: Data qualifies 'out of existence' as at least out of their existence.

evidence.observation: Picard creates the local institutional status of acting ensign for Wesley, grants Bridge access and duties, and directs preparation for a future Starfleet Academy application.
evidence.qualification: Records what the transcript depicts or reports; no global fictional-world promotion is implied.
